newsitem.title: THAILAND: Krung Thai Bank, Siam Commercial cut lending rates.
newsitem.headline: Krung Thai Bank, Siam Commercial cut lending rates.

text.p: Krung Thai Bank Plc and Siam Commercial Bank said on Monday they will cut lending rates by 25 basis points, effective on Tuesday.
After the cut, the new minimum lending rate (MLR) at Krung Thai Bank will be 12.75 percent while the new MLR at Siam Commercial Bank will be 13.00 percent, company officials told Reuters.
Both banks plan to cut their deposit rates also, but they would not give further details. The companies plan to release more information later in the day, the officials said.
Thailand's lending rates are among the highest in the region and range between 13 and 13.25 percent.
Central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond said earlier he expects banks to cut their rates in the coming weeks.
